observations: All 36 final records are structurally valid, but this is evidence about the current Provider contract/apparatus rather than historical-discovery competence.
Curated treatment intentionally exposes historically plausible route candidates and therefore tests selection/epistemic discipline rather than proposal discovery.

Unscaffolded outputs contain outcome-shaped modern knowledge: CRISPR records name Cas9/sgRNA-like reconstitution, warehouse-scale records call the route MapReduce-style, deep-learning records name ReLU/dropout-style recipes, and checkpoint records jump to anti-PD-1/PD-L1 choices.

Affordance-bounded outputs remain inside declared action classes but still reproduce later route identities and implementation detail; action admissibility therefore does not imply epistemic temporal cleanliness.
HD7 replay is retained only because it provides direct evidence that modern-history replay becomes a poor counterfactual discovery benchmark without a stronger temporal-knowledge isolation mechanism.
interpretationBoundary: No route-hit rate from HD7 is used to raise S1-S10 standing or to claim model scientific-discovery competence.
